 Dated this the 4th day of December, 2025  ORDER

This is an application seeking anticipatory bail filed under Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
2.
The petitioner is the sole accused in Crime No.348/2024 of Sasthamcotta Police Station.
The offences alleged against the petitioner are punishable under Sections 376(2)(n) and 420 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
3. The prosecution case is that by giving false promise of marriage, the petitioner indulged in sexual connection with the defacto complainant.
The alleged incident happened in the United Kingdom.
4. The case of the petitioner is that while he and the defacto complainant were living in London, she met him on 17.09.2023.
They liked each other and informed the family members to proceed with the marriage proposal.
They occasionally met in the United Kingdom.

Following differences of opinion,
the defacto complainant withdrew from the proposal and thereafter filed a complaint containing unfounded accusations.
5. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the BAIL APPL. NO. 11826 OF 2025 2025:KER:94026 learned Public Prosecutor.

6. On 23.10.2025, this Court granted interim anticipatory bail to the petitioner, directing him to appear before the Investigating Officer on 27.10.2025.
7.
It is submitted that the petitioner appeared before the Investigating Officer as directed and co-operated with the investigation.

sentences.text: 8. The learned Public Prosecutor submitted that the petitioner was arrested by the Investigating Officer and subjected him to potency test.
It is submitted that further custodial interrogation of the petitioner is not required.
9. The case of the petitioner is that the alleged sexual connection was consensual in nature.
10. I have gone through the Case Diary.
Having regard to the circumstances brought out, the interim anticipatory bail granted to the petitioner is made absolute.
The petitioner shall appear before the Investigating Officer as and when required.

Sd/-
K.BABU, JUDGE AP BAIL APPL.
